deployment._comment: Do this profile's sessions form ONE deployment whose ledger rows join into one history? MANDATORY — there is no safe default. Declare true only on a profile you are actually deploying; the CLI can narrow it (--one-off) but never widen it.

sentiment._comment: Wide on purpose — the SIGNAL plane must stay quiet so the only episode this profile produces is the injected TICK one.

execution._comment: High on purpose — the wall-clock staleness contract must not fire. This profile drills the PLANNED window, and a real outage beside it would make the two indistinguishable in the counts.

events._comment: data_source is the TICK source, so this is a STATUS-plane window: the ticks keep flowing and only the feed status is flagged (#444). A dead feed does not freeze the market.
events.label: tick feed status stale 10min
